honing_confound: World Decimation and Amplified Impact damage scales with Specialization (gear honing). Tier standing reflects T4 meta where burst output from Worldly Force identity window is maximized at peak honing.

delivery.evidence: Soulfist delivers ranged chi energy attacks. World Decimation is a large-range chi beam/explosion. Amplified Impact is a ranged strike. Soulfist Haki skills include ranged energy projectiles at medium range.

footprint.evidence: World Decimation creates a significant AoE at impact. Energy chi attacks have moderate AoE. Not as wide as Sorceress but more than pure single-target.

geo_text: Soulfist fires chi energy at medium range. Robust Spirit emphasizes the Worldly Force identity skills — these three skills (Worldly Force, Energy Bead, Energy Blast in levels 1/2/3 of the identity) scale with Haki energy level. At maximum Haki (Level 3), World Decimation is the apex burst skill. The rhythm is: manage Haki energy level → activate Worldly Force identity at maximum energy → burst.

control.evidence: Some Soulfist chi attacks apply knockback or slow effects. No primary CC identity.

defense.evidence: Soulfist has moderate mobility — not as fast as Wardancer but has chi-dash for repositioning.

economy.resource_verbatim: Haki Energy (3 levels: level 1, 2, 3) + Worldly Force Gauge
economy.builder_source: Haki-type skills generate Haki Energy. Energy increases through 3 levels — higher level = stronger Worldly Force identity skills. Separate Worldly Force Gauge activates the identity skill set.
economy.plain_text: THREE-LEVEL HAKI ECONOMY: Haki energy has 3 discrete levels (not a continuous bar). Skills and actions increase Haki level. At each level, Worldly Force identity skills (activated by identity Gauge fill) deal proportionally more damage. ROBUST SPIRIT IDENTITY: Worldly Force gauge activation is enhanced — higher damage at all Haki levels. The strategy is to TIME Worldly Force activation when Haki is at Level 3 for maximum burst output. Haki Level 3 = World Decimation available (strongest Worldly Force skill).

element.evidence: Soulfist chi attacks deal Physical/Holy damage depending on skill. World Decimation is a spirit-energy blast — likely Holy/Magic damage type.

movement.evidence: Chi dash skill provides repositioning. Soulfist has better mobility than pure melee classes but worse than Wardancer. World Decimation cast is rooted (major commitment).

attr.evidence: Soulfist attacks from medium range (not pure melee, not long-range like Sorceress). Chi energy projection extends reach.

range.evidence: Chi energy attacks: ~10-20m effective range. Melee skills for Haki generation: ~0-5m. Hybrid range profile.

tempo.evidence: Robust Spirit is the burst identity: manage Haki level → time Worldly Force activation at Level 3 → burst with World Decimation. Between activations = Haki management phase.

amp.value: Worldly Force identity at Level 3 Haki: World Decimation for maximum damage; Robust Spirit amplifies Worldly Force damage
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Robust Spirit specifically enhances the identity skill output at each Haki level.

commitment.evidence: World Decimation (the apex burst skill) has a significant charge animation. One of the longer committed casts in the MA archetype.

mechanics_notes: 1) Soulfist's three-level discrete Haki system is one of the most complex resource mechanics in LA: the identity is not 'fill a bar' but 'advance through 3 discrete energy levels' with a separate gauge for the identity skill activation. The two systems are orthogonal — Haki level affects power; Worldly Force gauge affects availability. 2) World Decimation is notable for its RANGE (long-range chi blast) which is unusual for a Martial Artist class — most MA classes are melee-primary. Soulfist occupies a 'ranged martial artist' niche. 3) Robust Spirit vs Energy Overflow represents 'burst chi' vs 'sustained chi' — Robust Spirit is about maximizing the single World Decimation window; Energy Overflow is about sustaining chi energy permanently at high level.
stabilization_patch: Robust Spirit was the meta choice historically for burst boss damage. Energy Overflow became competitive in 2023.
tier_standing_release: B-tier at launch (Soulfist overall had lower early population)
tier_standing_current: C-tier (community tier lists 2025; Soulfist is considered underperforming at T4 — Honing confound: World Decimation burst ceiling in T4 is competitive but the Haki management overhead makes it harder to execute vs simpler burst classes).

honing_confound: Energy Overflow's sustained chi damage scales with Swiftness (cast speed) which is gear-honing indexed. Tier standing reflects sustained output advantage at T4.

delivery.evidence: Same chi energy attack pool as Robust Spirit. Energy Overflow emphasizes continuous skill cycling rather than burst skill focus.

footprint.evidence: Same as Robust Spirit — moderate AoE from chi attacks.

geo_text: Energy Overflow maintains chi energy in a sustained 'overflow' state rather than cycling through 3 levels. The identity prevents Haki from depleting fully — energy remains constantly high, allowing sustained chi output without the level-management overhead of Robust Spirit. World Decimation is available but less emphasized.

economy.resource_verbatim: Haki Energy in sustained overflow state
economy.builder_source: Energy Overflow identity prevents Haki energy from dropping below a certain floor — sustaining constant high-chi output without level management.
economy.plain_text: OVERFLOW STATE: Energy Overflow prevents Haki energy from fully depleting. The class stays in a continuous 'high chi' state without needing to advance through 3 discrete levels. This shifts the identity from 'manage levels → burst at Level 3' to 'maintain overflow → sustain all chi skills at high power.' Worldly Force identity activation is less critical in the rotation — the sustained chi output IS the identity.

tempo.evidence: Energy Overflow is the sustained identity — the design removes level-management overhead for continuous output. No burst window to time.

amp.value: All chi skills sustained at high output; overflow state prevents energy depletion floor
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Specific multipliers not confirmed from live sources.

commitment.evidence: Same cast commitment as Robust Spirit for individual skills, but cycling faster in sustained identity.

mechanics_notes: 1) Energy Overflow is the Soulfist identity for players who prefer sustained output over the burst-timing discipline of Robust Spirit. The fundamental design is 'remove the three-level complexity, gain sustained high-chi-state.' 2) The Robust Spirit vs Energy Overflow fork parallels Igniter/Reflux and FI/ESE: burst-complex vs sustained-simple. This is a recurring LA design pattern that appears across at least 6 class pairs in the corpus. 3) Energy Overflow's 'floor' on Haki energy is a mechanic similar to World of Warcraft's 'Seal of Cleave' floor concepts — preventing resource drought at the cost of reducing the ceiling from full-level-3 burst. Trade-off is explicit.
stabilization_patch: Energy Overflow gained preference over Robust Spirit in 2023 when the community recognized sustained uptime was more practical in mobile raid environments.
tier_standing_current: C/B-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: same as Robust Spirit — Soulfist overall tier reflects class-level balance against the full T4 roster.
